form.title: Signed-in users suddenly getting logged out
form.impact: About a third of signed-in requests fail with 401; users are sent back to the login page.
form.details:
Shortly after the afternoon release window users started being bounced to the login page.
Logging in again works for a few seconds and then fails again. Both web and mobile are affected.
No infrastructure alerts apart from the gateway 401 rate.

expected_cause: v3.9.2 signs with kid 2026-11 but the JWKS cache (6h refresh) only knows 2026-10, and the old key is no longer published.
